capabilities: Visualize the vault as an interactive 3D graph of notes and links
Group notes into folder or tag clusters and collapse, isolate, or hide them
Search and filter notes by name, folder, tag, date, or connection count
Highlight shortest linked routes between two notes and take guided journeys through recent, forgotten, hub, or orphan notes
Customize visual styles, color profiles, backgrounds, animations, and performance budgets
extras: Installation requires manually downloading main.js, manifest.json, and styles.css from GitHub releases into .obsidian/plugins; the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Exploring a large vault's link structure is hard when the only graph view is flat and offers few ways to filter, cluster, or focus on parts of the network.
summary: 3D graph view that renders vault notes as nodes in an interactive three-dimensional space with clusters, filters, and optional animations.
